# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest published version of Home Assistant Tweaks receives security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.9.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.9.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within Home Assistant Tweaks, please do **NOT** open a public issue.

Instead, please report security vulnerabilities privately via GitHub's Private Vulnerability Reporting feature:

1. Navigate to the [Security Advisories](https://github.com/saihgupr/HomeAssistantTweaks/security/advisories) tab of this repository.
2. Click **Report a vulnerability**.
3. Provide detailed steps to reproduce the vulnerability, including any proof of concept or affected versions.

We appreciate responsible disclosure and will investigate and patch verified vulnerabilities promptly.
